articles.title: Cabinet Approves AgriData Governance Framework for AgriStack Infrastructure
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a landmark data governance policy securing farmer consent and privacy within the national AgriStack digital network.
prelims: AgriStack builds a national Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) linking Digital Crop Surveys and Land Records to unique Farmer IDs.
The AgriData Governance Framework incorporates consent management protocols governed by the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.
State governments act as primary custodians of verified land ownership data integrated into the central AgriStack hub.
articles.mains: Examine how Digital Public Infrastructure in agriculture can revolutionize credit delivery and targeted subsidies while safeguarding the data privacy of smallholders.

articles.title: RBI Tests Multi-CBDC Cross-Border Settlement Platform with ASEAN Partners
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India initiated pilot cross-border trade transactions using wholesale digital rupees (e₹-W) across selected ASEAN central banks.
prelims: Multi-CBDC (mCBDC) platforms enable direct bilateral clearing without reliance on traditional correspondent banking networks.
Wholesale CBDCs operate on Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) to achieve near-instantaneous settlement and lower transaction costs.
The mechanism helps reduce foreign exchange volatility and dependence on third-country reserve currencies in regional trade.
articles.mains: Analyze the strategic and economic implications of cross-border CBDC integration for India's external trade resilience and currency internationalization.

articles.title: UNEP Report Warns of Heightened GLOF Hazards Across High-Mountain Asia
articles.summary: A UNEP assessment highlights rapid glacier recession in the Himalayan region, urging accelerated installation of automated early warning systems.
prelims: High-Mountain Asia features the largest concentration of snow and ice outside the Earth's polar regions, feeding 10 major Asian river systems.
Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) occur when moraine or ice dams containing glacial lakes suffer sudden structural failures.
NDMA's National GLOF Risk Mitigation Project prioritizes synthetic aperture radar monitoring and real-time hydrological sensors in high-risk zones.
articles.mains: Evaluate India's disaster preparedness and institutional mechanisms in mitigating risks associated with Glacial Lake Outburst Floods in the fragile Himalayan ecosystem.

articles.title: India and Nordic-Baltic Nations Sign Compact on Green Hydrogen & Critical Minerals
articles.summary: India expanded bilateral ties with the Nordic-Baltic Eight (NB8) grouping to create robust supply chains for critical minerals and standard green hydrogen certificates.
prelims: The NB8 platform comprises Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, and Sweden.
The agreement aligns green hydrogen certification rules to facilitate seamless renewable fuel trade between South Asia and Europe.
Nordic countries hold strategic expertise in deep-sea geology, rare earth element processing, and offshore wind integration.
articles.mains: Discuss the potential of India-Nordic collaboration in facilitating technological transfers for the clean energy transition and critical mineral security.

articles.title: ICMR Releases Ethical Guidelines for Generative AI in Diagnostic Medicine
articles.summary: The Indian Council of Medical Research published national bioethical principles to guide clinical deployment and accountability of generative AI algorithms.
prelims: The framework mandates Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) oversight, retaining ultimate legal liability with treating physicians.
It establishes algorithmic auditing requirements to eliminate dataset bias against underrepresented demographic groups.
Explicit patient consent is made mandatory before clinical diagnostic tools process personal health information (PHI) via AI systems.
articles.mains: Discuss the ethical dilemmas posed by the integration of Artificial Intelligence in public healthcare, focusing on clinical accountability, data equity, and patient autonomy.
